system.description:
See Figurine of Wondrous Power

This marble statuette resembles a trumpeting elephant. It can become an Elephant for up to 24 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 7 days required before the figurine can be used again.

notes: not automated (summon): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
uses: a partial recovery refills the whole pool
summon: its creature is not among the converted creatures
